author: imryaan
body:
This is an evidence collection for a player that goes under the following names: Fhie, Selenas, School_Days & Cienti

NOTE: I'm not the best at analysing this kind of evidence so if you find any sketchy clips comment them below with the timestamp.

*I would recommend to watch these in 0.25x speed*

https://youtu.be/O15xppyFwbg?t=31s - The hits that he's getting aren't legit nor possible; he clearly has some kind of reach.

https://youtu.be/5LLOYtS1Uws?t=2m16s - Like the last clip, the reach he's getting is dodgy. 

https://youtu.be/5LLOYtS1Uws?t=3m8s - I'll let that explain itself..

https://youtu.be/O15xppyFwbg?t=1m14s - Blatant KA tbh

https://youtu.be/O15xppyFwbg?t=1m44s - I don't know how to explain that..

If anyone has evidence please comment below

- Ryan

replies.body:
**The hits that he's getting aren't legit nor possible; he clearly has some kind of reach.**
I was watching this part a lot of times but I can't find anything sketchy. The reach he's getting is normal and his hits are possible (at least in this clip)

**Like the last clip, the reach he's getting is dodgy.**
Same for this, nothing sketchy for me. Seems pretty normal (high ground advantage)

**I'll let that explain itself..**
This part is really sketchy, especially the 3rd hit he got (the guy in the water). Also, your POV makes it a little bit hard to see what's going on.

**Blatant KA tbh**
Sketchy, probably auto clicker?

**I don't know how to explain that..**
4.5 block reach, so yeah. Really sketchy.

That's basically my opinion on your evidence. As a conclusion, the current evidence is good but is not enough for a punishment but we will keep an eye on him. good job.
